SELECT /*LGUTLC00010.retrieveLoggingList*/ execution_yyyymm , a.application_user_id , NVL(b.full_name_local,b.english_full_name) AS employee_name , a.menu_id , c.menu_name AS menu_name , a.login_ip_addr , TO_CHAR(access_date,'YYYY-MM-DD hh24:mi:ss') AS access_date FROM LGCOM_SYSTEM_ACCESS_LOGGING_N a , LGCOM_USER_M_V b , LGCOM_MENU_M C WHERE a.application_user_id = b.application_user_id AND a.menu_id = c.menu_id
AND access_date >= TO_DATE(#{dateFrom},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND access_date < TO_DATE(#{dateTo},'yyyy-mm-dd')+1
AND a.application_user_id = #{userId}
AND (UPPER(b.full_name_local) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{employeeName}) || '%' OR UPPER(b.english_full_name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{employeeName}) || '%')
AND UPPER(a.menu_id) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{menuId}) || '%'
AND UPPER(c.menu_Name) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{menuName}) || '%'
AND (UPPER(login_ip_addr) LIKE '%' || UPPER(#{loginIpAddr}) || '%')
ORDER BY access_date
